name: past_tense
description: Give the simple past tense of an English verb (regular and irregular), few-shot. Control: same verbs and format, but copy the base form (present tense).
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
V=[('walk','walked'),('talk','talked'),('jump','jumped'),('play','played'),('work','worked'),('call','called'),('look','looked'),('want','wanted'),('go','went'),('see','saw'),('take','took'),('give','gave'),('eat','ate'),('run','ran'),('write','wrote'),('speak','spoke'),('drink','drank'),('sing','sang'),('swim','swam'),('drive','drove'),('buy','bought'),('think','thought'),('bring','brought'),('teach','taught'),('catch','caught'),('fly','flew'),('know','knew'),('grow','grew'),('throw','threw'),('draw','drew'),('break','broke'),('choose','chose'),('steal','stole'),('freeze','froze'),('begin','began'),('ring','rang'),('sit','sat'),('stand','stood'),('find','found'),('tell','told'),('sell','sold'),('feel','felt'),('keep','kept'),('sleep','slept'),('leave','left'),('meet','met'),('lose','lost'),('win','won'),('help','helped'),('open','opened'),('climb','climbed'),('cook','cooked')]
items=[];control=[]
for _ in range(120):
    ex=random.sample(V,3)
    items.append({"prompt":"Past tense.\n"+"".join(f"{a}: {b}\n" for a,b in ex[:2])+f"{ex[2][0]}:","answer":" "+ex[2][1]})
    control.append({"prompt":"Repeat the verb.\n"+"".join(f"{a}: {a}\n" for a,b in ex[:2])+f"{ex[2][0]}:","answer":" "+ex[2][0]})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
